excerpts.label: final
excerpts.text:
I opened PR #9 for issue #8. The AI spend section now stands out much more, but I only saw the result in downscaled screenshots.

- **Spend tile:** "Spent on AI" is now a large dark tile with an orange offset shadow. On desktop it spans two rows beside the other counters, and on mobile it takes the full width.
- **Other counters:** Tokens, runs, PRs and days are smaller raised cards with an accent top border.
- **Code:** Only CSS changed, plus one class added in `app.js` for the spend item. The numbers still come from the generated data. I also added a build-log entry for issue 8.
